patch_description: Follow the recommendation: co-sweep Stage 5's snap parameters as an atomic pair, lowering k from 0.6 to 0.45 (more permissive threshold catches more sub-noise steps, reducing false reversals/slope changes) while raising blend from 0.6 to 0.75 (removes those flagged steps more completely). The sign-hysteresis mask logic stays byte-identical since Gen 70's mechanism is validated. This targets false reversals (21.0, the strongest rank predictor) and slope_changes (24.2) while leaving lag/tracking untouched since genuine large steps still exceed the threshold and keep full response.
